pdsTitle: Northbank Life — Business Protection PDS extract
fictionNote: Summary of the Northbank Life — Business Protection PDS extract (PDS dated 1 July 2026) for Life Advice Guru's research. Read the PDS extract before relying on any wording.
summary: Buy-sell cover for business owners and key person cover for businesses, with fast financial underwriting based on the accountant's valuation and two years' financial statements. On Life Advice Guru's APL for business protection; Northbank's personal covers are in a separate PDS.
strengths: Buy-sell cover sized to each owner's share of the business value, with self-ownership or cross-ownership
Key person cover with the purpose recorded at application and the sum insured supported by the accountant's estimate of the loss
Fast financial underwriting: accepts the accountant's valuation and the last two years' financial statements, and usually decides within 5 business days
Loadings and exclusions reviewed on request after two years if the life insured's health results improve
watchPoints: Own-occupation TPD on business cover only works if the buy-sell agreement's TPD trigger uses the same definition — the lawyer needs to match it
Northbank requires a buy-sell agreement prepared by the owners' lawyer, and doesn't draft or review legal agreements
Northbank doesn't give tax or legal advice — the business confirms the tax treatment with its accountant

definitions.title: Buy-sell cover
definitions.wording: Life and TPD cover (trauma optional) on each business owner, sized to that owner's share of the business value, so the remaining owners can buy the share and the departing owner or their family receives its value. Self-ownership: each owner owns the policy on their own life and the benefit is paid to them, their nominated beneficiaries or their estate, with the buy-sell agreement setting out how the share is transferred. Cross-ownership: each owner owns a policy on the other owners' lives. Northbank requires a buy-sell agreement prepared by the owners' lawyer, and doesn't draft or review legal agreements.
definitions.plainEnglish: Each owner is insured so the remaining owner can buy their share and the family receives its value.

definitions.title: Key person cover
definitions.wording: Life and TPD cover (trauma optional) on a person whose death or disability would cost the business money. The business owns the policy and receives the benefit. The purpose is recorded at application: revenue (to replace lost profit while a replacement is found and trained) or capital (for example to repay business debt). The sum insured is supported by the accountant's estimate of the loss.
definitions.plainEnglish: The business insures a key person and receives the benefit.

definitions.title: Fast financial underwriting
definitions.wording: Northbank accepts the business valuation and the last two years' financial statements prepared by the business's accountant as financial evidence, and usually decides within 5 business days.
definitions.plainEnglish: The accountant's valuation and two years of accounts are enough — usually a decision within a week.

definitions.title: TPD on business cover
definitions.wording: Buy-sell and key person cover include TPD cover on the life insured (trauma optional). TPD is assessed on an own-occupation basis: the life insured is unlikely ever to work in their own occupation again because of illness or injury. The buy-sell agreement's TPD trigger should use the same definition.
definitions.plainEnglish: TPD is included and pays if the owner can never work in their own occupation again.

definitions.title: Medical underwriting
definitions.wording: Total life or TPD cover on one life: tele-interview for every application; blood profile from age 46 above $1,000,000; blood profile and medical examination from age 51 above $1,500,000.
definitions.plainEnglish: The medical evidence depends on age and the total cover on each life.

definitions.title: Loading and exclusion review
definitions.wording: Underwriting outcomes are standard rates, a loading (a percentage added to the premium, for example +25%), an exclusion, or a decline. Northbank reviews a loading or exclusion on request after two years if the life insured's health results improve.
definitions.plainEnglish: A loading can be reviewed after two years if health results improve.

definitions.title: How benefits are paid
definitions.wording: Benefits are paid only into an account in the policy owner's name (the business, for key person cover).
definitions.plainEnglish: The business receives key person benefits; buy-sell benefits go to the owner, their nominated beneficiaries or their estate.

definitions.title: Tax
definitions.wording: The tax treatment of premiums and benefits depends on who owns the policy and why it was taken out. Northbank recommends that the business confirm it with its accountant.
definitions.plainEnglish: Tax depends on ownership and purpose — the accountant confirms it.

features.title: Fast financial underwriting
features.detail: Accountant's valuation and two years' financial statements; usually a decision within 5 business days.

features.title: Self- or cross-ownership
features.detail: Buy-sell cover owned by each owner on their own life, or cross-owned.

features.title: Loading review
features.detail: Loadings and exclusions reviewed on request after two years if health results improve.

features.title: Cooling-off
features.detail: 14 days from the earlier of receiving confirmation of the policy and the end of the fifth business day after it is issued; not available once a claim has been made.

features.title: No genetic test results
features.detail: The insurer won't ask for or use genetic test results.

features.title: Adviser remuneration
features.detail: Commission of up to 60% of the first year's premium and up to 20% of later premiums (excluding GST), only with the client's informed consent.

exclusions.detail: Sums insured can't exceed the owner's share of the business value supported by the financial evidence.
Sums insured can't exceed the loss estimated by the business's accountant.
Business protection isn't available inside super.
Northbank doesn't draft buy-sell agreements and doesn't give tax or legal advice.
